title: Crispy Potato Bread Rolls 🥔🔥 crunchy tea-time snack #shorts

segments.moment_description: Getting ready to cook in the village kitchen
Shaping and coating the potato bread rolls
Deep-frying the rolls golden and crisp
Serving and sharing the crispy rolls

description:
Crispy Potato Bread Rolls 🥔🔥 — spiced mashed potato wrapped in soft bread and deep-fried till golden and crunchy. The perfect quick tea-time snack, crispy outside, soft and spicy inside.

Rolls or samosa — which crispy snack wins for you? 👇 Comment below!

🌿 Made with potatoes, green chilli, ginger, coriander and everyday spices, wrapped in plain bread — no fancy ingredients.

Did you know? Bread rolls use ordinary sandwich bread as the outer shell instead of dough — which is why they turn out shatter-crisp with almost no effort.
